# [More than 100 Years of Excellence in Innovation]

Since 1913, Sakata Seed Corporation has lived our values of Quality, Reliability and Service to
become a global leader in seed breeding and production. As industry innovators, our goal is to
continuously develop vegetable and ornamental varieties that offer superior performance and set new
standards for the industry. Headquartered in Yokohama, Japan, the Sakata Group currently has 29
offices in 22 countries around the world, with products available in more than 130 countries.
Sakata’s PASSION in Seed is realized by a dedicated global network of research and development,
production, and marketing teams.

# [More than 100 Years of Excellence in Innovation]

Since 1913, Sakata Seed Corporation has lived our values of Quality, Reliability and Service to
become a global leader in seed breeding and production. As industry innovators, our goal is to
continuously develop vegetable and ornamental varieties that offer superior performance and set new
standards for the industry. Headquartered in Yokohama, Japan, the Sakata Group currently has 29
offices in 22 countries around the world, with products available in more than 130 countries.
Sakata’s PASSION in Seed is realized by a dedicated global network of research and development,
production, and marketing teams.

### Research and Development

[research]

ACI Seed aims to ensure high-yielding, hybrid and best quality seeds for production of the best
quality crops of our country. ACI has already gained the trust of the farmers by marketing its high
yielding rice seeds, hybrid rice seeds and hybrid vegetables seeds. To ensure quality of seeds, ACI
has a team of expert agriculturists at Rural Development Association (RDA) of Bogra, who are
constantly working on producing quality seeds by field research and imports them to our farmers.
Besides this, it also indulges in crop distribution, agricultural advice sharing, and farmers
meetings along with various national and international agricultural research institutes and
universities.

goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them. 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Suite ][85]

call home.

[ [AGCO - Your Agriculture Company - Red and white logo] ][99]
AGCO (NYSE: AGCO) is a global leader in agricultural machinery and precision agriculture
technologies.

Driven by a Farmer-First strategy, AGCO delivers value through its differentiated leading brands,
Fendt™, Massey Ferguson™, PTx™ and Valtra™.  AGCO’s high-performance equipment and smart farming
solutions, including brand-agnostic retrofit technologies and autonomous offerings, empower farmers
to drive productivity while sustainably feeding the world.

[
[Baler Machine]

### Baler Machine

If you are engaged in animal husbandry, a hay baler is an indispensable partner for you. The ANON
hay baler can help compress freshly cut hay and other bulk crops into regular-shaped bales. After
baling, the forage has a smaller volume and higher density, making it easier to transport, store,

][66] [
[Disc Harrow]

### Disc Harrow

The disc harrow is key for prepping land. Hook it up to a tractor, and it can handle all sorts of
soil jobs. Farmers use it after plowing to break up big clumps of dirt, which loosens the ground and
makes it flat. This helps when it's time to plant seeds. It also makes it easier for plants to get
nutrients from the soil. Plus, it clears away leftover crops after harvest and works the topsoil on
empty fields. ANON has many types to pick from. Our disc harrows can do it all, and we have a team
that's ready to answer your questions and give you great service. We sell top-quality farm equipment
that helps you grow great crops!
][67] [
[Harvester]

### Harvester

ANON harvesters deliver comprehensive, high-efficiency harvesting solutions for everything from
conventional grains to specialty crops. Harvesters that easily handle different crops and
different field conditions, all in ANON!
][68] [
[Lawn Mowers]

### Lawn Mowers

ANON lawn mower is an efficient and intelligent lawn mowing device, whose technology and design aim
to improve mowing efficiency while reducing energy consumption. Lawn mowers achieve the purpose of
cutting grass by driving the blades to rotate or reciprocate at high speed through an engine.
According to different homework methods, the cut grass can be directly thrown, crushed and returned
to the field, or collected in a grass box. You can choose the appropriate lawn mower based on the
desired treatment effect. We also have multiple types of lawn mowers for you to choose from!
][69] [
[Plow]

### Plow

ANON sells a tractor implement accessory – the plow. Plows are commonly used in tillage operations
to improve the working environment and soil quality for agricultural producers. They improve soil
structure by turning over the topsoil, exposing nutrients in the subsoil. Therefore, under certain
workloads, the efficiency and durability of a plow are crucial. More importantly, ANON plows are
consistently refined in both manufacturing processes and performance.
][70] [
[Seeder]

### Seeder

## **Adjustable Seeder Manufacturer**

ANON seeders are built for efficient crop planting across different farmland conditions. The
machines support planting varieties of crops such as corn, wheat, soybeans, sorghum, amaranth,
cabbage, and potatoes. Different seeding trays can be customized to meet your diverse planting
needs. Suitable for small-scale and commercial farming -Has an adjustable planting depth structure.
-Uniform seed distribution arrangement. -Multi-row planting configuration. -Seed and fertilizer
combined planting system.
][71]
[
[Sprayer]

### Sprayer

At ANON, we offer a wide range of agricultural sprayer equipment designed to help farmers
efficiently protect crops and apply fertilizers, ultimately boosting both yield and crop quality. We
provide a variety of sprayer types to suit different needs, including manual sprayers, electric
sprayers, motorized sprayers, drone sprayers, tractor-mounted or trailed sprayers, and atomizing
sprayers. Each type has its own advantages and is suitable for different field sizes and crop
requirements. Choosing the right sprayer for your specific situation can significantly improve your
productivity and ensure the healthy growth of your crops. If you have any questions about our
products, please feel free to leave us a message online. We're here to help you find the best
solution for your farm!
][72] [
[Thresher]

### Thresher

Still using traditional manual methods to thresh your crops? It’s time for a change—ANON
Agricultural Threshers are here to free your hands and transform your harvest!

ANON agricultural threshing machines are widely used in the field to efficiently separate grains
from the crop heads or pods—whether it’s wheat, rice, corn, peanuts, or more.

Our product range includes grain threshers, corn threshers, bean threshers, and multi-functional
threshing machines, all designed to provide farmers with reliable and time-saving threshing
solutions.

Whether you manage a large-scale farm or a small family plot, our threshers are built to make your
job easier and more efficient.

Choose ANON threshing machines—make threshing effortless, boost your productivity, and enjoy the
satisfaction of a successful harvest!

][73] [

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

  with default settings). Also tweaked Grove/Jagged Peaks colors and added custom world border

  rough height ranges of cave biomes in map marker popups. Apr 1, 2026

  and the Tiny Takeover update! Mar 24, 2026

  2026
* The updated map experience is now enabled by default. Thanks to everyone who tried it, shared
  feedback, and helped find and fix issues! Mar 9, 2026
* An updated map experience is coming to Chunk Base with smoother scrolling, customizable markers,
  and more! For now, it's opt-in at [chunkbase.com/apps/seed-map][10]. Let me know if you run into
  any issues! Jan 21, 2026
* Have fun with the Mounts of Mayhem drop this holiday season! As a heads-up, the seed map
  generation is unchanged. Dec 9, 2025

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

# Greenhouse Gas Mitigation in Rice

Assisting the Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification of GHG Reductions in Rice Cultivation

# [][48]
# Providing GHG Mitigation and MRV Expertise

The International Rice Research Institute dedicates its technical expertise to developing national
strategies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and implementing Monitoring, Reporting, and
Verification (MRV) systems in rice cultivation.

## [][49]
## Low-emission technologies transform Viet Nam’s rice sector

In 2020, Viet Nam increased its Nationally Determined Contribution target for the agriculture sector
for 2030 by 16MtCO2-eq. 100% of the unconditional target was to come from rice production.

Three major challenges had to be overcome: insufficient emission data, policy endorsement, and
demonstrating that emission mitigation is complimentary to agriculture.

Today, Viet Nam serve as a knowledge pool of tried and tested methods for greenhouse gas mitigation
in rice.

## [][50]
## IRRI's GHG Mitigation and MRV Tools

# [][51]
# Tried and Tested in Viet Nam

### [][52]
### [RICEMORE][53]

[
][54]

Rice activity Monitoring and Reporting System (RICEMORE) is designed to monitor and plan rice
cultivation at central and local agriculture offices. It enhances accurate and effective data
management and reporting for climate-responsive decision-making.

### [][55]
### [FARMORE][56]

[
][57]

Farm-activity Monitoring and Reporting (FARMORE) is a performance assessment application to track
and assess sustainability performance of agroecological practices for systematic, time-series data
recording and reporting of farmers.

### [][58]
### [COMPARE][59]

[
][60]

COMPARE is a cost-impact analysis tool for emission reduction projects to calculate Cost-Benefit
indicators and GHG emissions of different rice management practices. It incorporates eight rice
production methods.

### [][61]
### [SECTOR][62]

[
][63]

The Source-selective and Emission-adjusted GHG Calculator (SECTOR) is a greenhouse gas calculator
for croplands. It provides a streamlined framework for data entry that facilitates rapid assessments
for multiple emission scenarios.

### [][64]
### [MapAWD][65]

[
][66]

The Mapping Alternate Wetting and Drying tool (MapAWD) evaluates the bio-physical suitability of the
AWD water-saving technique in rice cultivation. A location specific water balance model is used to
analyze climatic-suitable areas.

### [][67]
### [DISPLAY][68]

[
][69]

The Digital Information System for Rice Product Labeling and Yield (DISPLAY) estimates the carbon
footprint of rice across its value chain from cultivation to processing.

### [][70]
### [CF-RICE][71]

[
][72]

Carbon Footprint of Rice tool (CF-RICE) is a calculator for carbon footprints under product-specific
settings and technological alternatives for conventional and mitigation-conform rice production.

# Greenhouse Gas Mitigation in Rice

Assisting the Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification of GHG Reductions in Rice Cultivation

# [][48]
# Providing GHG Mitigation and MRV Expertise

The International Rice Research Institute dedicates its technical expertise to developing national
strategies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and implementing Monitoring, Reporting, and
Verification (MRV) systems in rice cultivation.

## [][49]
## Low-emission technologies transform Viet Nam’s rice sector

In 2020, Viet Nam increased its Nationally Determined Contribution target for the agriculture sector
for 2030 by 16MtCO2-eq. 100% of the unconditional target was to come from rice production.

Three major challenges had to be overcome: insufficient emission data, policy endorsement, and
demonstrating that emission mitigation is complimentary to agriculture.

Today, Viet Nam serve as a knowledge pool of tried and tested methods for greenhouse gas mitigation
in rice.

## [][50]
## IRRI's GHG Mitigation and MRV Tools

# [][51]
# Tried and Tested in Viet Nam

### [][52]
### [RICEMORE][53]

[
][54]

Rice activity Monitoring and Reporting System (RICEMORE) is designed to monitor and plan rice
cultivation at central and local agriculture offices. It enhances accurate and effective data
management and reporting for climate-responsive decision-making.

### [][55]
### [FARMORE][56]

[
][57]

Farm-activity Monitoring and Reporting (FARMORE) is a performance assessment application to track
and assess sustainability performance of agroecological practices for systematic, time-series data
recording and reporting of farmers.

### [][58]
### [COMPARE][59]

[
][60]

COMPARE is a cost-impact analysis tool for emission reduction projects to calculate Cost-Benefit
indicators and GHG emissions of different rice management practices. It incorporates eight rice
production methods.

### [][61]
### [SECTOR][62]

[
][63]

The Source-selective and Emission-adjusted GHG Calculator (SECTOR) is a greenhouse gas calculator
for croplands. It provides a streamlined framework for data entry that facilitates rapid assessments
for multiple emission scenarios.

### [][64]
### [MapAWD][65]

[
][66]

The Mapping Alternate Wetting and Drying tool (MapAWD) evaluates the bio-physical suitability of the
AWD water-saving technique in rice cultivation. A location specific water balance model is used to
analyze climatic-suitable areas.

### [][67]
### [DISPLAY][68]

[
][69]

The Digital Information System for Rice Product Labeling and Yield (DISPLAY) estimates the carbon
footprint of rice across its value chain from cultivation to processing.

### [][70]
### [CF-RICE][71]

[
][72]

Carbon Footprint of Rice tool (CF-RICE) is a calculator for carbon footprints under product-specific
settings and technological alternatives for conventional and mitigation-conform rice production.

### Introduction of the factory

Qingdao Hans Machinery Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2014, is dedicated to producing various
types of agricultural machinery. Our products include hand-push seeders, vegetable planters,
fertilizers, harvesters, walking tractors, and various crop processing equipment such as threshers
for corn, soybeans, and rice. Additionally, we also provide irrigation and livestock machinery,
offering comprehensive solutions for agriculture in various countries. With a dedicated team of 6
R&D personnel, 70 production workers, and professional after-sales service, Qingdao Hans Machinery
Technology Co., Ltd. ensures timely and comprehensive support for customers. Choose us for reliable
equipment and seamless integration from planting to harvesting, contributing to agricultural
development worldwide!

[ About Us ][25]
Play Video

##### Shipping

We partner with reliable shipping companies for swift global delivery, ensuring goods reach their
destination promptly.

##### ENV Protection

Our equipment uses eco-friendly materials, preventing pollution to farmlands and meeting
environmental standards.

##### Best Offers

Direct factory sales offer the most competitive prices. Price protection for agents ensures
competitive pricing.

##### Quality

Customer feedback drives continuous improvement in our product quality.

In recent years, we have collaborated with African governments to promote our agricultural machinery
products in the local market, and have gained a good reputation. At the same time, our agricultural
machinery products have also been exported to the United States, Middle East, Europe and other
countries and markets.

Welcome to the

# Hardy Plant Society

The Hardy Plant Society is dedicated to promoting plant knowledge, fostering communities, enhancing
well-being, championing the environment, and facilitating research and partnerships. Our members
find relaxation, happiness, and joy in gardening.
[
Find Out More
][72]
Supporting the

## Hardy Plant Society

## By supporting the HPS, you’re joining a movement that believes in the joy of plants and the goal
## of sharing that joy as widely as possible. You’re advocating for a charity where knowledge about
## these amazing organisms is shared, where communities come together over the love of gardening,
## and where every individual recognises the therapeutic and environmental benefits of plants.

[
JOIN US
][73]
[Image]
Why join the

## Hardy Plant Society?

## The HPS has activities for every plants person and gardener

[Image]
Meet like-minded individuals
Meet other members in a local group for talks, plant sales and conversation. Most groups meet
monthly during the winter, and also organise trips and online events
[Image]
Learn from others
Members have access to the latest plant articles and news within our two magazines The Hardy Plant
and The Newsletter. Members will have full access to our plant library and the option to receive
Cornucopia too.
[Image]
Help our world
Choose to take part in our Conservation Scheme to preserve and propagate less well known plants.
Members also benefit from our Seed Distribution Scheme providing access to hundreds of seeds from
growers around the country.
[Image]
Member benefits
As part of the HPS, you will be able to ask for plant advice, attend a talk, go to a plant sale.
Members or non-members can apply for bursary funding.
[
JOIN US
][74]
“Our group has excellent talks which touch on plants other than hardy perennials which I always
enjoy. I have learnt a great deal which has enhanced my time in the garden and my love and
appreciation of plants. I enjoy the Journals and am very happy to be an HPS member. From J. T. in
Rutland.”
“The HPS has completely changed the way I approach gardening, opening me up to plants I never knew
existed and had never thought of growing. All my friends who have benefited from all the plants I
have grown over the years would I am sure, like to thank you for all your hard work. From T.M. in
Powys”
“I would be lost without the HPS and the people I have met through the society. The knowledge I have
gained both by talking to fellow members and speakers is incalculable. The meetings are usually a
place of joy for me. From R.B. in Lincolnshire”

# Planting seeds of happiness

**Pioneers in hybrid seeds, plants and garden inputs**

×

###### Welcome to INDAM

## Where every seed is a promise, every plant an embodiment of nature’s beauty, and every service a
## testament to excellence.

In a world where agriculture is not just a livelihood but a way of life, INDAM stands as a symbol of
happiness and progress.

### Impact
### beyond farms

The nutritional value provided by INDAM seeds reaches every plate and palate of people across the
nation and the globe.

### Harness
### hybrid seeds

Our disease-tolerant hybrid seeds showcase greater resilience in challenging growing conditions.

### Ornamental
### plants

Each plant is meticulously selected to thrive in various environments, so you experience its
enduring beauty.

### Farming
### communities

We foster sustainable agriculture and farmer’s well-being, nurturing communities for a brighter
tomorrow.




###### Our vision

To plant the seeds of happiness in the lives and spaces of the people – from farms to homes to
workplaces and every other living space of the planet.

# K-Agriculture | Quality Is King

## About K-AGRICULTURE

K-Agriculture Company is a subsidiary of King Global Trade International Joint Stock Company (King
Global., Jsc) – a reputable international trading corporation specializing in agricultural exports.
Established in 1996 as a small merchant with the original goal to export rice, corn, and nut from
Vietnam to China. Over the years, our company has expanded to include more Vietnamese-branded
products such as coffee and cashew nuts. In 2020, powered by the Vietnam Ministry of Industry and
Trade, K-Agriculture became the National Project mission of bringing high-quality Vietnamese
agricultural goods to the international market.

With the ambition of becoming a leading company in the field of agricultural exports, we are
constantly improving ourselves, building a modern facility to meet the market’s ever-increasing
demands. So far, K-Agriculture has successfully present in fastidious markets over the world such as
Africa, the USA, and Japan.

## About K-AGRICULTURE

K-Agriculture Company is a subsidiary of King Global Trade International Joint Stock Company (King
Global., Jsc) – a reputable international trading corporation specializing in agricultural exports.
Established in 1996 as a small merchant with the original goal to export rice, corn, and nut from
Vietnam to China. Over the years, our company has expanded to include more Vietnamese-branded
products such as coffee and cashew nuts. In 2020, powered by the Vietnam Ministry of Industry and
Trade, K-Agriculture became the National Project mission of bringing high-quality Vietnamese
agricultural goods to the international market.

With the ambition of becoming a leading company in the field of agricultural exports, we are
constantly improving ourselves, building a modern facility to meet the market’s ever-increasing
demands. So far, K-Agriculture has successfully present in fastidious markets over the world such as
Africa, the USA, and Japan.

## Who We Are

Kubota uses a wide range of products and technologies to provide solutions in the areas of food,
water, and the environment, which are indispensable for people's lives. From a grain of rice or a
drop of water to the foundations of society and industry, Kubota's solutions support the lives of
human beings.
* ### [Agriculture][170]
  
  As a comprehensive solutions provider for agriculture, Kubota offers total support at every stage
  of farming, from developing agricultural machinery that meets farmers' needs to the production,
  processing and consumption of agricultural products. Kubota supports farming throughout the world
  and contributes to a more prosperous future for people and food.
  
  [
  ][171]
* ### [Water][172]
  
  Kubota's water environment solutions are active in all aspects of the water cycle, supporting
  water infrastructure in Japan and throughout the world. As a water treatment specialist, we are
  committed to finding solutions to the world's water problems and supplying safe water to all
  people in the world.
  
  [
  ][173]
* ### [Environment][174]
  
  Social infrastructure is indispensable for our prosperous and comfortable lives. Industrial
  infrastructure serves as the foundation for manufacturing. Kubota answers the needs of society to
  offer solutions that support these infrastructures, contributing to more affluent lives for
  humans.
  
  [
  ][175]

[Groundwork for Tomorrow][176]

## Innovation

Kubota envisions the social issues that could arise in the near future and creates new services and
business and develops products in anticipation if these issues, contributing even further to
society.

[Learn More][177]

## Sustainability

Kubota considers food, water and the environment as a singular theme, and aims to realize a
sustainable society through a proper cycle of these elements using technology and solutions.

[Learn More][178]

## Who We Are

Kubota uses a wide range of products and technologies to provide solutions in the areas of food,
water, and the environment, which are indispensable for people's lives. From a grain of rice or a
drop of water to the foundations of society and industry, Kubota's solutions support the lives of
human beings.
* ### [Agriculture][170]
  
  As a comprehensive solutions provider for agriculture, Kubota offers total support at every stage
  of farming, from developing agricultural machinery that meets farmers' needs to the production,
  processing and consumption of agricultural products. Kubota supports farming throughout the world
  and contributes to a more prosperous future for people and food.
  
  [
  ][171]
* ### [Water][172]
  
  Kubota's water environment solutions are active in all aspects of the water cycle, supporting
  water infrastructure in Japan and throughout the world. As a water treatment specialist, we are
  committed to finding solutions to the world's water problems and supplying safe water to all
  people in the world.
  
  [
  ][173]
* ### [Environment][174]
  
  Social infrastructure is indispensable for our prosperous and comfortable lives. Industrial
  infrastructure serves as the foundation for manufacturing. Kubota answers the needs of society to
  offer solutions that support these infrastructures, contributing to more affluent lives for
  humans.
  
  [
  ][175]

## Serving for Humanity and Dignity

WHO WE ARE
LEDARS (Local Environment Development and Agricultural Research Society) is a non- profit and
non-political organization working for the social, economic, and environmental development of the
poor and marginalized people of the southwest region of Bangladesh since 1996. LEDARS has been
registered by the Social Welfare Department and NGO Affairs Bureau, Government of Bangladesh. LEDARS
is very much engaged with climate change, climate resilience, gender development nature base
solutions, environmental conservation, drinking water, WASH, livelihoods, youth development, etc.
till now LEDARS has obtained several national and international awards including the Zayed
Sustainability Prize 2023, for its innovative and sustainable initiatives. LEDARS is working with
marginalized communities like landless, marginal farmers, schedule casts, labour, women-headed
families, children, and adolescents.

## The Touch of a Mini Pond Transforms Sandhya Rani and a Village

SUCCESS STORY

In the remote village of Khutikata, Shyamnagar, Satkhira, the story of 52-year-old Sandhya Rani
Sarkar unfolds as a testament to resilience and transformation. Once a destitute housewife,
Sandhya’s days were consumed by the struggle to provide for her sick husband and children. Her
husband, a day laborer, earned little, and Sandhya often had to rely on collecting cow dung from
grazing fields to scrape together a meager existence. Without the ability to repay loans, even
neighbors and relatives turned her away in times of need……..

## Our Professional Team

MEET EXPERT TEAM
[ Mohon Kumar Mondal ][71]
Founder & Executive Director
Mohon Kumar Mondal, Founder and Executive Director of LEDARS (Local Environment Development and
Agricultural Research Society). He is post postgraduate in Geography from the National University,
Bangladesh, and completed a short course from BIARI, Brown University, Roads Island, USA on Disaster
Management and Humanitarian response. He has been working in the development field from student life
(since 1995). He is the founder and Executive Director of a nonprofit organization, LEDARS. He has
taken part in national and international events in his professional life. He was awarded by the
State Department of USA’s International Visitor Leadership Program (IVLP) in 2012. He attended the
4th and 7th World Water Forums in Mexico in 2006 and Korea in 2015 and presented a success story of
LEDARS for grassroots development in the water sector. He attended several UNFCCC’s Conference of
Parties (COP-15 and 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28 and 29). LEDARS has been awarded the 3rd Prize World
Water Showcase Award in 2015, the Channel I Standard Chartered Agro award, and the Zayed
Sustainability Prize in 2023 under his leadership. He is a member of the US State Alumni Association
in Bangladesh.
[ A.B.M Zakaria ][72]
Program Manager
A.B.M. Zakaria, Program Manager at LEDARS, holds a postgraduate degree in English from Jagannath
University and has over two decades of experience in integrated program management. His expertise
spans program planning, MEAL (Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning) frameworks,
stakeholder engagement, fundraising, and team building, with a particular focus on climate
resilience and community development. At LEDARS, he leads the implementation of innovative
development projects aimed at empowering vulnerable communities in Bangladesh's climate-affected
coastal regions. His commitment to sustainable development and Human Rights drives his efforts to
ensure impactful and qualitative program outcomes. He is instrumental in initiating new programs,
developing fundraising strategies, and enhancing the organization's visibility and reach. With his
rich experience and dedication, he is focused on addressing climate challenges and advancing LEDARS’
mission to support communities in building resilience and sustainable livelihoods.
[Mst. Laila Khatoon]
[ Mst. Laila Khatoon ][73]
Project Coordinator
Mst. Laila Khatoon serves as the Project Coordinator for the "Strengthening Livelihood Security of
Climate Change Vulnerable People" project at LEDARS. With over five years of experience in the
development sector, she is a passionate activist and advocate for women's rights. Her expertise
spans land, agriculture, climate change, leadership, and capacity building at the grassroots level.
She is specializes in mobilizing marginalized communities, coordinating impactful programs, and
implementing development initiatives. She has a strong track record in team management,
communication, networking, and monitoring, ensuring the success and sustainability of her projects.

## Serving for Humanity and Dignity

WHO WE ARE
LEDARS (Local Environment Development and Agricultural Research Society) is a non- profit and
non-political organization working for the social, economic, and environmental development of the
poor and marginalized people of the southwest region of Bangladesh since 1996. LEDARS has been
registered by the Social Welfare Department and NGO Affairs Bureau, Government of Bangladesh. LEDARS
is very much engaged with climate change, climate resilience, gender development nature base
solutions, environmental conservation, drinking water, WASH, livelihoods, youth development, etc.
till now LEDARS has obtained several national and international awards including the Zayed
Sustainability Prize 2023, for its innovative and sustainable initiatives. LEDARS is working with
marginalized communities like landless, marginal farmers, schedule casts, labour, women-headed
families, children, and adolescents.

## The Touch of a Mini Pond Transforms Sandhya Rani and a Village

SUCCESS STORY

In the remote village of Khutikata, Shyamnagar, Satkhira, the story of 52-year-old Sandhya Rani
Sarkar unfolds as a testament to resilience and transformation. Once a destitute housewife,
Sandhya’s days were consumed by the struggle to provide for her sick husband and children. Her
husband, a day laborer, earned little, and Sandhya often had to rely on collecting cow dung from
grazing fields to scrape together a meager existence. Without the ability to repay loans, even
neighbors and relatives turned her away in times of need……..

[ Mohon Kumar Mondal ][71]
Founder & Executive Director
Mohon Kumar Mondal, Founder and Executive Director of LEDARS (Local Environment Development and
Agricultural Research Society). He is post postgraduate in Geography from the National University,
Bangladesh, and completed a short course from BIARI, Brown University, Roads Island, USA on Disaster
Management and Humanitarian response. He has been working in the development field from student life
(since 1995). He is the founder and Executive Director of a nonprofit organization, LEDARS. He has
taken part in national and international events in his professional life. He was awarded by the
State Department of USA’s International Visitor Leadership Program (IVLP) in 2012. He attended the
4th and 7th World Water Forums in Mexico in 2006 and Korea in 2015 and presented a success story of
LEDARS for grassroots development in the water sector. He attended several UNFCCC’s Conference of
Parties (COP-15 and 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28 and 29). LEDARS has been awarded the 3rd Prize World
Water Showcase Award in 2015, the Channel I Standard Chartered Agro award, and the Zayed
Sustainability Prize in 2023 under his leadership. He is a member of the US State Alumni Association
in Bangladesh.
[ A.B.M Zakaria ][72]
Program Manager

University and has over two decades of experience in integrated program management. His expertise

stakeholder engagement, fundraising, and team building, with a particular focus on climate
resilience and community development. At LEDARS, he leads the implementation of innovative
development projects aimed at empowering vulnerable communities in Bangladesh's climate-affected
coastal regions. His commitment to sustainable development and Human Rights drives his efforts to
ensure impactful and qualitative program outcomes. He is instrumental in initiating new programs,
developing fundraising strategies, and enhancing the organization's visibility and reach. With his
rich experience and dedication, he is focused on addressing climate challenges and advancing LEDARS’
mission to support communities in building resilience and sustainable livelihoods.

NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT, AND NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT

## What is mcseedmap.net?

An online Minecraft seed map viewer and seed finder that helps you locate biomes and structures and
find the seeds you want.

It shows a browseable map for a given seed with biomes, terrain estimation, and structures like
Villages and Ocean Monuments.

It also can be used to find seeds with specific biomes and structures within a given area.

## FAQ

### About Minecraft

#### What is a seed?

A Minecraft world seed is a unique number or string of characters that is used to initialize the
random generator when creating a new world in Minecraft. This seed determines the layout of terrain,
structures, and other features in the world. The same seed generates the same world every time,
allowing players to share seeds to explore the same world or create specific landscapes.

#### Are Java and Bedrock seeds the same?

Since Minecraft version 1.18, seeds generate the same terrain and biomes on Java and Bedrock
editions, but trees, grass and structures will be different.

#### How do I get my Minecraft world seed?

If it's your own world, then it's easy.

**For Java Edition:** while playing, press `T` to open the chat, type `"/seed"` without the quotes,
and press ENTER. The game will show the seed.

**For Bedrock Edition:** open world settings, you will find the seed on the Advanced page (or on the
Game page if you opened the settings while playing).

In the case of **server or Realms worlds**, if it's not your own server, you can often only find out
the seed by asking the server owner.

### About mcseedmap.net

#### What is a seed map?

A Minecraft seed map is a visual representation of a Minecraft world generated using a specific
seed. It shows the layout of terrain, biomes, structures, and other features of the world, allowing
players to preview what the world will look like before actually creating it in the game. Seed maps
can help players choose interesting or desirable worlds to explore or build in.

#### How accurate is it?

Biomes are pretty accurate. Note that the actual shorelines of rivers and oceans do not follow biome
boundaries exactly.

Structure positions are accurate to within a few blocks, but some structures may be missing, and
there may be structures that are not generated in the game.

Java structure finding is more accurate than Bedrock because there is more information available
about the algorithms.

Spawn positions can be completely wrong for some seeds. Java spawn estimation is more accurate than
Bedrock.

#### Is it cheating?

While using a seed map can reveal the locations of biomes or structures like End Portals without the
need for exploration or Ender Eyes, whether it's considered cheating is subjective and depends on
the player's perspective. Some players enjoy the challenge of finding structures through
exploration, while others prefer to use tools like seed maps for convenience. Ultimately, it's up to
each player to decide what they consider fair or enjoyable in their gameplay experience.

#### Why is the map not loading?

The site uses modern technologies such as WebAssembly, which are not supported by older browsers.
Check that you have updated your browser to the latest version.

Pro tip!
If you are more serious about seeds, need high performance and advanced seed finding features, the
open source [Cubiomes Viewer][1] desktop app is for you.

## News

* The map now shows biomes at the actual terrain surface level instead of at Y=320. This does not
  change anything for surface biomes, but cave biomes that are exposed at the surface, such as

* Added support for [Java Edition 26.2][6] and [Bedrock Edition 26.30][7] ([Chaos Cubed][8] game

  map!

### Warning about illegal copies and fake seed mapping sites

Almost every week, a new seed mapping website appears online. Some are original and legitimate
projects, usually based on cubiomes, some others are illegal copies of mcseedmap.net. These copies
often look and work exactly like mcseedmap.net because they just ripped my code and other assets as
a whole. Please use caution, as some of these sites redirect visitors to malware or other malicious
stuff. I am not affiliated with any of these sites.

## Credits

mcseedmap.net is created by Balázs Farkas ("megasys"), the author of [uNmINeD][15].

It is not vibe-coded, it is the result of many years of human effort by me and other contributors.

different visual style.

Java datapack maps are calculated using a library created by me.

Bedrock 1.16 and 1.17 biomes and Bedrock Nether are calculated using a [cubiomes fork][18] by Reed
A. Cartwright.

Bedrock structure calculation is based on information from [Bedrockified][19] by Earthcomputer and
from [MCBEStructureFinder][20] by xiaohengying.

finally finding the ones that result in the correct positions.

Map colors are from cubiomes (some are slightly adjusted), inspired by [Amidst][21].

The user interface was built on [Mantine][22].
The map is displayed using [OpenLayers][23].

Translations were made using ChatGPT with limited human revision.

mcseedmap.net is protected and accelerated by Cloudflare® services.

Open source Minecraft libraries used:
* [Bedrockified][24] by Earthcomputer
* [cubiomes][25] by Cubitect
* [cubiomes fork][26] by Reed A. Cartwright
* [MCBEStructureFinder][27] by xiaohengying

Thanks to all users who provided feedback and suggestions 🙏

Mojang or Microsoft.

## Frequently asked questions
* ### Can I create a Prezi presentation from my PowerPoint slides?
  
  Yes. Prezi makes it easy to transform your existing PowerPoint presentation into something
  dynamic. Simply upload your PowerPoint slide deck to Prezi Present, and our tools will help you
  convert it into an interactive Prezi presentation. You can also import files from Google Slides or
  Keynote by exporting them as PDFs first.
* ### What is Prezi’s AI presentation maker?
  
  Prezi AI is an AI presentation maker that helps you create a complete, polished presentation from
  a prompt or uploaded file, like a PDF, PPT, or DOC. It generates a structured draft with suggested
  slide titles, key points, and design theme so you can move from idea to presentation faster.
* ### How does Prezi's AI presentation designer work?
  
  Prezi's AI presentation designer turns your ideas into polished presentations effortlessly. After
  entering a prompt or uploading an existing file like a PDF or Word document, Prezi AI generates a
  complete presentation with customized layouts, AI images, and visual elements. You can then make
  final tweaks with our AI image generator and text editor before presenting.
* ### Can Prezi create a PowerPoint (PPT) with AI?
  
  Yes. If you want an AI PowerPoint presentation maker workflow, you can use Prezi AI to draft your
  presentation quickly and then export or share it in the format your team needs, like exporting to
  a PowerPoint.
* ### Can I turn an existing document into a presentation with AI?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI can help you create a presentation with AI from existing content. Add a prompt or
  upload content, and Prezi AI generates an outline and slide-by-slide draft with layouts and
  visuals you can refine. You stay in control and can edit text, reorder slides, and adjust design
  before presenting.
* ###  Is Prezi a free AI presentation tool?
  
  Yes, Prezi is available as a free presentation software with AI-powered features included. If you
  want unlimited access to Prezi AI, you can try a free trial or upgrade to a paid subscription. No
  matter which subscription you choose, you will be able to present with Prezi's unique format that
  makes content more engaging and memorable.
* ### How is Prezi different from other AI presentation generators?
  
  While most AI presentation tools force your content into generic templates, Prezi AI takes a
  smarter approach. Based on your unique content, Prezi AI generates a presentation with custom
  design, colors, and images specifically tailored to your message, no templates required. Your
  content provides all the direction needed to create a truly personalized presentation.
* ### What types of presentations can I create with Prezi AI?
  
  With Prezi AI, you can create presentations for work, school, and personal projects, including
  pitch decks, reports, lessons, and slide presentations. If you are looking to make a presentation
  with AI for work or school, Prezi AI can help you draft faster and present more effectively.
* ### Does Prezi AI help with slide structure and talking points?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI helps with the parts that take the most time, like organizing ideas into a logical
  flow and creating a consistent design.
* ### Can I edit the AI-generated presentation?
  
  Absolutely. Prezi AI creates a draft, but you can fully edit it. Update the text, rearrange
  slides, and tailor the visuals so the final result matches your brand, audience, and goals.
* ### Is Prezi good for creating slide decks with AI for teams?
  
  Yes. Prezi works well for collaborative workflows where multiple people need to review, refine,
  and align on messaging. If you’re looking for an AI presentation software that keeps presentations
  consistent across your organization with shared collaboration features and team-friendly controls,
  [Prezi for Teams][24] is an ideal solution.

* ### Can I create a Prezi presentation from my PowerPoint slides?
  
  Yes. Prezi makes it easy to transform your existing PowerPoint presentation into something

  convert it into an interactive Prezi presentation. You can also import files from Google Slides or

* ### What is Prezi’s AI presentation maker?
  
  Prezi AI is an AI presentation maker that helps you create a complete, polished presentation from
  a prompt or uploaded file, like a PDF, PPT, or DOC. It generates a structured draft with suggested
  slide titles, key points, and design theme so you can move from idea to presentation faster.
* ### How does Prezi's AI presentation designer work?
  
  Prezi's AI presentation designer turns your ideas into polished presentations effortlessly. After

  complete presentation with customized layouts, AI images, and visual elements. You can then make
  final tweaks with our AI image generator and text editor before presenting.

* ### Can I turn an existing document into a presentation with AI?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI can help you create a presentation with AI from existing content. Add a prompt or

  visuals you can refine. You stay in control and can edit text, reorder slides, and adjust design
  before presenting.

* ### How is Prezi different from other AI presentation generators?
  
  While most AI presentation tools force your content into generic templates, Prezi AI takes a
  smarter approach. Based on your unique content, Prezi AI generates a presentation with custom
  design, colors, and images specifically tailored to your message, no templates required. Your
  content provides all the direction needed to create a truly personalized presentation.
* ### What types of presentations can I create with Prezi AI?
  
  With Prezi AI, you can create presentations for work, school, and personal projects, including

  with AI for work or school, Prezi AI can help you draft faster and present more effectively.
* ### Does Prezi AI help with slide structure and talking points?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI helps with the parts that take the most time, like organizing ideas into a logical
  flow and creating a consistent design.

  Absolutely. Prezi AI creates a draft, but you can fully edit it. Update the text, rearrange
  slides, and tailor the visuals so the final result matches your brand, audience, and goals.

Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. possible.

[Reimagine][26]

# Sustainable Rice Agriculture

Explore how our decades of research and development and field-tested results are transforming rice
agriculture.

#### Reducing Labor

Savannah leads the way in creating the ability to substantially reduce or eliminate the
back-breaking labor associated with rice farming worldwide.

#### Improving Performance

Our hybrid rice seeds are known for their exceptional performance, delivering higher yield and
consistent results even under abiotic stresses. By continuously working to meet local quality
requirements tailored to consumer demands, our customers realize increased farm performance. This
unwavering commitment to performance and reliability makes RiceTec a trusted seed partner.

#### Saving Water

Our hybrids are more robust and exhibit better abiotic stress tolerance, enabling a shift to more
sustainable water management practices such as direct seeded rice (DSR), alternate wetting and
drying (AWD), and row rice. These practices reduce water usage and enhance sustainability while
maintaining productivity.

#### Controlling Weeds

Getting ahead of the weeds in the field through innovative and broad-spectrum herbicide seed and
cropping solutions.

#### Lowering Emissions

Traditional rice farming contributes about 20% of global agricultural methane emissions. RiceTec
hybrids offer a solution by emitting less methane compared to varieties, thereby reducing emissions.
By planting RiceTec hybrids and adopting sustainable water management practices, farmers can further
lower greenhouse gas emissions. 

### Sustainable rice agriculture that creates value for farmers, consumers, and the planet.

At Savannah, we’re committed to revolutionizing rice production. That commitment drove us to
commercialize hybrid rice seed in India and its surrounding countries. As a technology-based rice
company, we’re still innovating today with a focus on products that bring high value to the growers
who choose to plant our seed.



#### SINGLE FOCUS

The only seed player in the world with a single focus on rice.



#### GLOBAL FOOTPRINT

The only one with serves the world with the best in rice genetics.



#### PROVEN SUCCESS

The technology, hybridization, and transformation of rice cultivation.

SmartRice is developed by using a new generation breeding platform that delivers highly-efficient

[Reimagine][26]

# Sustainable Rice Agriculture

Explore how our decades of research and development and field-tested results are transforming rice
agriculture.

#### Reducing Labor

Savannah leads the way in creating the ability to substantially reduce or eliminate the
back-breaking labor associated with rice farming worldwide.

#### Improving Performance

Our hybrid rice seeds are known for their exceptional performance, delivering higher yield and
consistent results even under abiotic stresses. By continuously working to meet local quality
requirements tailored to consumer demands, our customers realize increased farm performance. This
unwavering commitment to performance and reliability makes RiceTec a trusted seed partner.

#### Saving Water

Our hybrids are more robust and exhibit better abiotic stress tolerance, enabling a shift to more
sustainable water management practices such as direct seeded rice (DSR), alternate wetting and
drying (AWD), and row rice. These practices reduce water usage and enhance sustainability while
maintaining productivity.

#### Controlling Weeds

Getting ahead of the weeds in the field through innovative and broad-spectrum herbicide seed and
cropping solutions.

#### Lowering Emissions

Traditional rice farming contributes about 20% of global agricultural methane emissions. RiceTec
hybrids offer a solution by emitting less methane compared to varieties, thereby reducing emissions.
By planting RiceTec hybrids and adopting sustainable water management practices, farmers can further
lower greenhouse gas emissions. 

### Sustainable rice agriculture that creates value for farmers, consumers, and the planet.

At Savannah, we’re committed to revolutionizing rice production. That commitment drove us to
commercialize hybrid rice seed in India and its surrounding countries. As a technology-based rice
company, we’re still innovating today with a focus on products that bring high value to the growers
who choose to plant our seed.



#### SINGLE FOCUS

The only seed player in the world with a single focus on rice.



#### GLOBAL FOOTPRINT

The only one with serves the world with the best in rice genetics.



#### PROVEN SUCCESS

The technology, hybridization, and transformation of rice cultivation.

About Us

## We Entertain Only Overseas Inquiries

In 1995 and 1996, there was a significant demand for agricultural equipment all around the world.
Due to suppliers' excessively aggressively high-priced, subpar quality farm machinery, the market
was extremely competitive. Since there were numerous businesses, they started producing using
standard tools and technology. Because they couldn't charge enough for high-quality products, the
manufacturer of quality machinery was forced to close. The company's founder and CEO, Mr. Sasidharan
Govindan, a commerce graduate, considered diversifying agriculture machines during the competition.
He also obtained information about the state of the upcoming market and experimented with the
products and materials that were in increasing demand in India. Eventually, he came to the
conclusion that there is a strong global market for purchases and that our agricultural machinery
and technologies are progressing significantly.

Sabin Enterprises exports agricultural machinery from companies including Massey Ferguson, Mahindra,
Sonalika, and Swaraj. Among many other products, we provide combine harvesters, self-feeding
multi-crop power threshers, rotavators like the Yodha and the Disc Harrow, precision planters,
tractor-mounted cultivators, and reaper binders. We guarantee global standards as a small-scale
member of the Engineering Export Promotion Council and the All-India Exporters Chambers. Numerous
customers are drawn to our goods by their great performance, usability, and uncompromising design.
Our outstanding market standing, sizable sales volume, and 40 years of business experience have
earned us the trust of clients worldwide. Additionally, we export our goods to Kenya, Tanzania,
Panama, Ghana, Dubai, Sudan, Bahrain, Cook Island, Djibouti, Ethiopia, Morocco, the Netherlands, the
Antilles, Oman, the Philippines, Qatar, Rwanda, South Africa, the United Arab Emirates, Zambia, and
other nations.

## What is seedancetwo?

Seedance two accepts four modality inputs — image, video, audio, and text — for richer expression
and more controllable generation.

### Reference Image

Precisely reproduce composition, character details, and visual style from a reference image.

### Reference Video

Replicate camera movements, complex motion rhythms, and creative effects from a reference video.

### Video Extension

Smoothly extend and connect shots — generate continuous scenes guided by your prompts. Not just
generation, but "keep shooting."

### Video Editing

Swap characters, remove or add elements in existing videos with targeted edits.

## Core Capabilities Significantly Enhanced: More Stable, Smoother, More Realistic!

Beyond multimodal, Seedance 2.0 delivers major improvements at the foundational level — more
accurate physics, more natural and fluid motion, more precise instruction following, and more
consistent style. It handles complex actions, continuous motion, and other challenging generation
tasks with ease, making every video more realistic and polished. A true evolution in core
capabilities!

## Full Multimodal Upgrade: Video Creation Enters the "Free Combination" Era!

Upload text, images, video, or audio — all can serve as source material or references. Reference any
content's motion, effects, style, camera work, characters, scenes, or sound. As long as your prompts
are clear, the model understands. Seedance 2.0 = Multimodal reference ability (reference anything) +
Strong creative generation + Precise instruction response (excellent comprehension).

## Overall Consistency Fully Improved

Characters looking different between shots, product details lost, small text blurred, scene jumps,
inconsistent camera styles... These common consistency issues in creative work are now resolved in
2.0. From faces to clothing to font details, overall consistency is more stable and accurate.

## Core Capabilities

"Reference ability" is the biggest highlight. Use an image to set the visual style, a video to
specify character movements and camera changes, a few seconds of audio to set the rhythm and mood...
Combined with prompts, the creative process becomes more natural, more efficient, and more like
being a real "director."

### Overall Consistency

Character faces, outfits, text, and details stay highly consistent across multiple shots.

### Camera & Motion Replication

Upload a reference video to replicate complex choreography and camera movements — no frame-by-frame
descriptions needed.

### Creative Template / Effect Replication

Creative transitions, ad spots, film clips, and other complex effects can all be precisely
reproduced.

### Creative & Story Completion

The model autonomously completes storylines and creative details, making narratives richer and more
natural.

### Video Extension

Smoothly extend and connect shots — generate continuous scenes guided by prompts. Not just
generation, but keep shooting.

### More Accurate Tone, More Realistic Voice

Natural and lifelike voice timbre with greatly enhanced expressiveness for dialogue and narration.

### Smoother Long Takes

No breaks in long shots — natural scene transitions with greatly enhanced continuity.

### Highly Usable Video Editing

Make targeted edits to specific segments of existing videos without regenerating the entire clip.

### Music Beat Sync

Audio beats align precisely with on-screen actions, giving videos a strong sense of rhythm.

### Better Emotional Performance

More nuanced facial expressions and body language for stronger narrative impact.

## What is seedancetwo?

Seedance two accepts four modality inputs — image, video, audio, and text — for richer expression
and more controllable generation.

### Reference Image

Precisely reproduce composition, character details, and visual style from a reference image.

### Reference Video

Replicate camera movements, complex motion rhythms, and creative effects from a reference video.

### Video Extension

Smoothly extend and connect shots — generate continuous scenes guided by your prompts. Not just
generation, but "keep shooting."

### Video Editing

Swap characters, remove or add elements in existing videos with targeted edits.

## Core Capabilities Significantly Enhanced: More Stable, Smoother, More Realistic!

Beyond multimodal, Seedance 2.0 delivers major improvements at the foundational level — more
accurate physics, more natural and fluid motion, more precise instruction following, and more
consistent style. It handles complex actions, continuous motion, and other challenging generation
tasks with ease, making every video more realistic and polished. A true evolution in core
capabilities!

## Full Multimodal Upgrade: Video Creation Enters the "Free Combination" Era!

Upload text, images, video, or audio — all can serve as source material or references. Reference any
content's motion, effects, style, camera work, characters, scenes, or sound. As long as your prompts
are clear, the model understands. Seedance 2.0 = Multimodal reference ability (reference anything) +
Strong creative generation + Precise instruction response (excellent comprehension).

## Overall Consistency Fully Improved

Characters looking different between shots, product details lost, small text blurred, scene jumps,
inconsistent camera styles... These common consistency issues in creative work are now resolved in
2.0. From faces to clothing to font details, overall consistency is more stable and accurate.

## Core Capabilities

"Reference ability" is the biggest highlight. Use an image to set the visual style, a video to
specify character movements and camera changes, a few seconds of audio to set the rhythm and mood...
Combined with prompts, the creative process becomes more natural, more efficient, and more like
being a real "director."

### Overall Consistency

Character faces, outfits, text, and details stay highly consistent across multiple shots.

### Camera & Motion Replication

Upload a reference video to replicate complex choreography and camera movements — no frame-by-frame
descriptions needed.

### Creative Template / Effect Replication

Creative transitions, ad spots, film clips, and other complex effects can all be precisely
reproduced.

### Creative & Story Completion

The model autonomously completes storylines and creative details, making narratives richer and more
natural.

### Video Extension

Smoothly extend and connect shots — generate continuous scenes guided by prompts. Not just
generation, but keep shooting.

### More Accurate Tone, More Realistic Voice

Natural and lifelike voice timbre with greatly enhanced expressiveness for dialogue and narration.

### Smoother Long Takes

No breaks in long shots — natural scene transitions with greatly enhanced continuity.

### Highly Usable Video Editing

Make targeted edits to specific segments of existing videos without regenerating the entire clip.

### Music Beat Sync

Audio beats align precisely with on-screen actions, giving videos a strong sense of rhythm.

### Better Emotional Performance

More nuanced facial expressions and body language for stronger narrative impact.

### [ World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews: an International Journal ][23]

## WJARR is an International ISSN Approved Journal

**World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews (WJARR)** is an international journal dedicated to
the publication of high-quality research and review articles. WJARR is an ISSN approved journal with
e-ISSN **2581-9615**. The journal is an **open access** publication issued with a monthly frequency
(12 issues per year).

World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews is a **peer-reviewed and highly indexed journal**
ensuring quality scholarly publication. The journal offers authors an affordable publication process
with very low publication fees. WJARR maintains a high impact factor (Impact factor 8.2) and is
committed to providing authors with a timely and efficient review process for evaluation of their
manuscripts.

The journal publishes **original research articles, review articles, mini-reviews, short
communications, and case reports** across a wide range of scientific disciplines including
Biological Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Medical Sciences, Nursing, Health Sciences,
Agriculture, Life Sciences, Engineering and Technology and other related fields.

The aim of WJARR is to establish a global platform for exchanging ideas and new emerging trends
within the scientific community. The journal is committed to publishing articles that strengthen the
knowledge of academicians, researchers and scientists. Each manuscript is selected for its original
contribution to scholarly research and is reviewed to ensure intellectual rigor and relevance to
academic and professional communities.

### Why publish in World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews?
* ISSN Approved Journal
* International Journal with e-ISSN 2581-9615
* Peer-Reviewed Journal with fast track review process
* High quality publication standards
* High Impact factor Journal (Impact factor 8.2)
* Google Indexed Journal – articles indexed by Google
* Crossref Indexed Journal – DOI assignment without extra charges
* Indexed in several national and international indexing services
* Open Access Journal – authors retain copyrights
* Simple manuscript submission via email or online system
* Free certificate of publication for all authors

### How to Publish in World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews

**Authors who wish to publish research or review articles in the international journal World Journal
of Advanced Research and Reviews should submit their manuscript via email attachment to:**

**Email: **[**editor@wjarr.com**][28]

Authors familiar with online submission systems may submit their manuscript through the online
submission link available on the journal website.

Before submission, authors should ensure that the manuscript follows the **WJARR author
guidelines**. Authors are required to send a covering letter and author declaration form. All
authors should also review the journal’s publication ethics and malpractice policy.

Submitted manuscripts must not have been published or submitted elsewhere. Only original and
plagiarism-free articles will be considered. All manuscripts undergo **double blind peer review**
and final decisions are based on quality, originality and contribution to existing knowledge.

An acknowledgement of manuscript submission will be sent to the corresponding author by email.
